QuestInfo.name: Never Give Up
QuestInfo.0: Big Headward seems sad. See what's bothering him.
QuestInfo.1: Get some hair supplies for Big Headward: #bPig Oil x20#k from #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Big Headward some hair supplies. He looked too happy for you to tell him that no amount of hair styling would make him look good.

0.0: Ahh... I'm really depressed right now. Why, you ask? I haven't styled my hair in days. I never imagined I would look like this. It's all because of the Cygnus Knights.
0.1: I'll be honest. I haven't given up on the path of a stylist yet. What can I say? I was born to hold scissors, not a sword.

yes.0: Wow! Thank you very much! I need #b#t4032940# x20#k, which you can get from #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k! If you do that, I can make my secret Big Headward's Hair Gel.
yes.1: And yes, of course I need that much. Have you seen the size of my head? Look... I really need this.

no.0: I see. You're busy... Well... okay.

0.2: I don't want to lose my styling skills, in case peace ever returns. But I'm out of supplies...
0.3: Could you get me some hair supply materials? I beg you! I might go insane if I spend too long not styling my hair!

1.0: Did you get everything I needed?

yes.0: Oh! You're my savior! Thank you very much! Okay, now to make some hair gel... Finally, I'll look my best again!
yes.1: Of course, I haven't forgotten my duty to protect the town! I believe I can do that AND go on styling.

item.0: Yes, I need #b#t4032940# x20#k from #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k! It's for a good cause!
